Declare
 vt_lov boolean;
 Begin
 IF :CTRL_BLK.V_TYPE IS NOT NULL THEN
 Begin

 raise form_trigger_failure;
 End;
 End if;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_PROPERTIES
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_properties (field_name1 IN varchar2, no_entry OUT number,
 r_chk OUT varchar2, f_chk OUT varchar2) IS
 F_required varchar2(1);
 f_double number; 
 F_func varchar2(1); 
begin
 
 select required, no_of_entries , function_check
 into f_required, f_double , f_func
 from find_donor_fields
 where program_name = :banner.prog_name and
 field_name = field_name1;
 if f_required = 'Y' then
 nullchk; check_package_failure;
 end if;
 no_entry := f_double;
 r_chk := F_required;
 F_chk := f_func;
 
exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('9206');
 check_package_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_NAVIGATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE SET_NAVIGATION (F_NAME IN VARCHAR2,FLG IN VARCHAR2) IS
BEGIN
 IF FLG = 'T' THEN 
 set_item_property(F_NAME,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSE
 set_item_property(F_NAME,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_false);
 set_item_property(F_NAME,ENABLED,PROPERTY_false);
 END IF;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETRIEVE_DATA
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE retrieve_data IS
 query_count number :=0;
begin
 if :CTRL_BLK.VEHICLE_ID is null then
 go_item('ctrl_blk.vehicle_id');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 begin
 SELECT COUNT(*) INTO query_count 
 FROM VALID_VEHICLES
 WHERE VEHICLE_ID = :CTRL_BLK.VEHICLE_ID 
 AND CHAPTER_ID = :GLOBAL.CHAPTER_ID;

 IF query_count <> 0 THEN
 go_block('valid_vehicles');
 execute_query(no_validate);
 begin
 select count(*) into :global.query_count
 from central_notes 
 where note_id = :valid_vehicles.note_id 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and rownum=1;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 go_block('central_notes');
 if (:global.query_count > 0) then
 execute_query;
 else
 clear_block(NO_VALIDATE);
 end if;
 --item_change('ctrl_blk.vehicle_name','D');
 go_item('valid_vehicles.vehicle_name');
-- go_item('valid_vehicles.vehicle_type');
 ELSE
 --item_change('valid_vechicles.vehicle_name','D');
 go_item('valid_vehicles.vehicle_name');
 END IF;
 end;
end;
